senses.gloss: m. du. (b. h.; כלא, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) junction of two, esp. Kilayim, the forbidden junction of heterogeneous plants in the same field, of heterogeneous animals by hybridization or by harnessing together, of wool and linen in the same web (Lev. XIX, 19; Deut. XXII, 9 to 11).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:15">Gen. R. s. 82</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5:6">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵇ</cite> top <he>האש והכ׳ וכ׳</he> fire and hybrids (mules) although not having been created in the six days &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:1">Kil. VIII, 1</cite> <he>כְּלָאֵי הכרם</he> mixed seeds in the vineyard.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:1">Ib. I, 1</cite> <he>אינם כ׳ זה בזה</he> are no forbidden junction.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>משום כ׳</he> as coming under the law of K.—
Tosef. ib. III, 16 כשית אינו כ׳ cuscuta is not forbidden (in the vineyard); Sabb. 139ᵃ; a. v. fr.—Kilayim, name of a treatise of the Mishnah and Tosefta, of the Order of Z’raïm.
